issues.title: Low contrast header text
issues.description: Header labels have insufficient contrast against the glass bar.
issues.evidence: Praxis Cloud and Sandbox text elements blend into the dark grey translucent header.
issues.suggestion: Increase text opacity or use a lighter foreground color token.
issues.triageNote: Real in-component defect fixed: StrategyBadge inactive label/dot used hardcoded neutral-400 (≈2.5:1 in dark) → theme-aware muted-foreground (≈5.8:1 in dark; verified rendering at rgb(143,140,132) on pair-077). The specific flagged captions are page-authored in the off-limits eval file and their tokens are AA-fine undimmed (Praxis Cloud = text-default-font ≈13:1; Sandbox = neutral-500 ≈5.3:1); pixel probe showed they read at ~40% brightness because the eval page's open non-modal ds:Sheet paints a z-50 rgba(0,0,0,0.6) overlay over the whole viewport — composition/blocked-external (ds:Sheet + eval page).
